entryWatch.setup: DG discount-retail reclaim - Dollar General reported fiscal Q2 2026 on 2026-08-27 am, EPS 2.23 against a 1.99 estimate, a 12.06% beat verified on a live per-symbol pull. The 8/27 gap was fully round-tripped by the 8/28 close of 122.89, eleven cents above the 122.78 pre-print close, and the name then RECLAIMED: 8/31 opened 123.47, held 122.725 and closed 126.75 for +3.14% on 4.19M shares against roughly 2M typical, taking back the 125.89 close of the reaction bar. SPECIFIED at 09:47 at a 128.40 limit for 3 shares, CLEAN, no checklist item marked fail. CONFIRMED at 10:22 and CONFIRMED AGAIN at 11:22, the limit untouched on both passes. The deterioration is entirely in fill probability, not in the thesis - and at 11:22 the two limbs the 10:22 run flagged as weakening had both partly REVERSED.
entryWatch.trigger: CONFIRMED LIVE AT 11:22 BY THE SECOND HOURLY RE-QUOTE, NOT KILLED, AND THE LIMIT IS UNCHANGED AT 128.40 FOR A SECOND HOUR. DG is 131.03 bid / 131.21 ask at 2026-09-01T15:22:26.036693554Z, last 131.135, +3.38% against a 126.75 settled close, on a 0.18 spread or 0.137% of mark. ALL THREE NAMED INVALIDATIONS CHECKED SEPARATELY. ONE, a trade below 126.24: NOT TRIGGERED - across the full twenty-two-bar 13:30Z-15:15Z series the 126.24 low was set on the opening bar and the lowest low of the twenty-one bars since is 129.9638 on the 15:00Z bar, so the level has not been approached. TWO, a close below 125.89: PENDING until the close, DG 5.14 or 4.08% above it. THREE, the cohort failing: NOT TRIGGERED and stronger again - DLTR 131.29 bid at +3.71% against +3.47% at 10:22 and +2.62% at strike. THE DECAY THE 10:22 RUN FLAGGED DID NOT CONTINUE, IT PARTLY REVERSED: GAP has flipped BACK red at -1.08% against +0.27%, ANF has deepened to -1.94% from -0.41% and WSM to -2.49% from -1.63%, leaving BBY at +1.37% the only green name among the seven non-discount retailers, so the split reads NINE-FOR-TEN against eight-for-ten an hour ago. The counterweight is stated too: off-price is sold less hard than it was - TJX -0.07%, ROST -0.40%, BURL -1.08% - and TJX at seven basis points is close to crossing. THE VOLUME LIMB ALSO PARTLY REVERSED: after eight bars between 3,739 and 13,122 shares, the 15:00Z bar traded 24,205 and the 15:15Z bar 31,743 while DG ran 130.04 to 131.06, the third-heaviest bar of the session. FILL PROBABILITY IS THE ONE THING THAT KEEPS DETERIORATING: the limit sat 0.38% below the bid at 09:47, 1.51% at 10:22 and 2.01% now - and DG last printed under 128.40 in the 13:45Z bar at a 128.375 low, roughly ninety minutes ago, with all sixteen bars since holding above 129.35. IT IS STILL NOT RAISED - widening the time was never permission to widen the price, and confirming a spec is not improving it. Expires 15:30 ET today.
entryWatch.why: Item 3 is na on a dated fact rather than skipped: DG's next report is 2026-12-03 on a live per-symbol pull, three months past the 9/8 time stop, so there is no earnings hold for a straddle to precede. moves.json branch one is checked and does not bind - it covers AVGO itself and semiconductor or enterprise-software sympathy names, and a discount retailer is neither. THE COHORT READ IS THE LOAD-BEARING PART AND IT IS A SPLIT, NOT A RALLY: DLTR +2.62%, WMT +0.59% and DG +1.69% bid while TJX -0.43%, ROST -0.74%, BURL -2.32%, WSM -2.58%, BBY -0.50%, ANF -0.41% and GAP -0.45% are red. Retail is not bouncing; deep-discount trade-down names are being bought on a second consecutive risk-off day. DG is the LAGGARD of the bid pair and the only one carrying a fresh catalyst, which is the sympathy-laggard setup the rulebook names. THE WEAKNESS, STATED BEFORE THE OUTCOME: this is a RECLAIM, not the day-2 continuation the rulebook prefers, because a fully round-tripped gap has no move left to continue. Yesterday this board refused DG in exactly those terms and took SJM instead; that refusal is confronted rather than reversed in silence, and what changed is two sessions of evidence. OPTIONS REFUSED ON SPREAD: the 3-6 week window on DG contains only weeklies - 9/18 is 2.4 weeks, 10/16 is 6.4 weeks, so both monthlies are excluded by the rule itself - and the tightest of eight near-money 10/02 calls quotes 40.6% of mark with zero volume, widening to 95.1%, while the 9/25 128c quotes 73.9%. Equity quotes 0.31%.

The 8/31 reaction bar opened 140.39, ran 142.66, printed a 127.10 low and closed 128.22 on 1.86M shares against roughly 400k typical - a gap-and-fade that gave back nearly all of an 11.5% pop. Today opened 127.01 and printed 124.05 within five minutes, so the name is now BELOW its own 125.96 pre-print close and BELOW yesterday's 127.10 low. entryWatch.why: Recorded at length because it is the control case that gives DG's reclaim its meaning: two names, two round-tripped earnings gaps, and only one of them turned on rising volume. SAIC also had the larger beat, which is the point - the size of the beat did not decide the outcome and the tape did. The 0.95 spread on a 124.835 mark, 0.76%, is a second and independent mark against it.

entryWatch.setup: SJM breakout pullback - the 8/31 specification at a 132.10 limit, killed at 15:21 by the final hourly
entryWatch.trigger: NOT RE-STRUCK, AND THE REASON IS THE SETUP RATHER THAN THE PRICE. SJM is 131.80 bid / 132.40 ask at 2026-09-01T13:42:19.983Z, last 132.25, +0.49% against a 131.16 settled close, so the dead 132.10 limit is back inside the spread and could in principle be published again. It is not, because the thing that justified it is gone: the 8/31 bar made a lower low at 131.15 and a lower close at 131.16, breaking the rising-lows sequence of 128.12, 128.90, 131.10, 131.645 that was the entire technical case, and the relative-strength read failed outright on its eighth check at -0.816% against SPY -0.356%. A level that is available again is not the same as a setup that is still there.
entryWatch.why: Kept as the record of a distinction this board has to keep making: the 15:21 kill was mechanical, on the limit sitting above the offer, and was explicitly NOT the 131.10 invalidation firing. Today the invalidation still has not fired - the 8/31 low was 131.15, five cents above it - and the entry is still refused. That is the correct shape: a spec can die on price and the thesis can die separately and later, and blurring them is how a board talks itself back into a trade.
